body.name: EOTCDev API
body.description: Open calendar data for the Ethiopian Orthodox Tewahedo Church: date conversion, fasting days, fasting periods, and feasts.
body.note: All Ethiopian years are Amete Mihret. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. No auth, no API key; a generous anonymous rate limit applies.

endpoints.GET /v1/fasting/{date}: Is it a fasting day, and why. ?calendar=gregorian|ethiopian
endpoints.GET /v1/fasts/{year}: All fasting periods of an Ethiopian year.
endpoints.GET /v1/feasts/{year}/{key}: One feast resolved for a year, by key, name, or alias.
endpoints.GET /v1/feasts/search: Find a feast by any of its names, homophone-aware. ?q=&year=
endpoints.GET /v1/calendar/{year}/{month}: One Ethiopian month, day by day.
endpoints.GET /v1/calendar/range: Describe a date range, up to 366 days. ?start=&end=&calendar=
endpoints.GET /v1/gitsawe/{date}: Fixed-cycle Gitsawe with Sinksar and canonical Bible links.
endpoints.GET /v1/gitsawe/feasts: The feast graph: feasts, sub-feasts, and mahlet service orders.
endpoints.GET /v1/gitsawe/mahlets/{id}: One mahlet service order with its chant roles.
endpoints.GET /v1/sinksar/{date}: The day's Sinksar annual and monthly commemoration lists.
endpoints.GET /v1/readings/{date}: Daily Psalms, Gospels, Epistles and Acts from the Gitsawe.
endpoints.GET /v1/bible/books: The canon: book metadata and verse counts. ?testament=&section=
endpoints.GET /v1/bible/books/{id}: One book with per-chapter verse counts.
endpoints.GET /v1/bible/parse: Parse a citation into a canonical reference. ?q=
endpoints.GET /v1/bible/{edition}/{book}/{chapter}: Chapter reference; verse text only on licensed self-hosts.
endpoints.POST /v1/calendar/convert/batch: Convert many dates at once. body: {dates:[], calendar?}

seasons.title: ዘዓርብ ተፍጻሜተ ጾመ ፵ ዘውእቱ ተፅዒኖ
ከ፯ እስከ ፲፫ ታኅሣሥ ስብከት ይባላል።
ከ፲፬ እስከ ፳ ታኅሣሥ፡ ብርሃን ይባላል።
ከ፳፩ እስከ ፳፯ ታኅሣሥ ኖላዊ ይባላል።
እምዕርገት እስከ ጰራቅሊጦስ፥ ፯ኛ እሑድ ክትንሣኤ በኋላ
እም፲ወ፯ ለሰኔ እስከ ፳ወ፭ አስተምህሮ ይትበሀል
አመ ፳ወ፮ ለሰኔ በዓተ ክረምት እስከ ቂርቆስ ዘርዕ ደመና ይትበሀል
፫ተኛ ለእመ ኮነ በዓለ ሐዋርያት በእሑድ መዝሙር አሠርገዎሙ ለሐዋርያት
መዝሙር (በታች ቤት) በቀዳሚ ገብረ እግዚአብሔር፡ (በላይ ቤት) አርውዮ
መዝሙር ዘፍልሰታ ንዒ ርግብየ (በታች ቤት)፤ አዕረግዋ (በላይ ቤት)
ለእመ ኮነ እሑድ በጳጉሜን፡ መዝሙር ከመ እንተ መብረቅ።
